raw_response: {"diagnosis":"Twenty txn_ids were delivered twice within batch 13, at 02:00 and again at 22:00. The copies differ only in amount, so the later delivery looks like a restated correction. Silver has no dedup step, so both copies were kept and the gold aggregates are inflated. I am keeping the latest ingest_ts per txn_id, but nothing in the change notes confirms that later copies are corrections, so this is an assumption.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.68,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT * FROM raw_transactions QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY ingest_ts DESC, batch_id DESC) = 1) r WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
